records.Name: Home case study B
records.Home_Title__c: Choosing the right platform for a literacy nonprofit
records.Headline_Metric_Label__c: software licence cost for 10 staff users
records.Challenge__c: A small staff with no full time admin needed one system for students, volunteers and training partners, inside a tight grant budget.
records.Solution__c: Advised against Education Cloud, which is built and priced for large institutions. Chose donated Sales and Service licences with free NPSP and Program Management over Nonprofit Cloud, for a cheaper path past ten seats. Left donations where they already ran.
records.Business_Value__c: Ten staff users on donated licences, with staff testing the build in user acceptance before production.

records.Name: Home case study A
records.Home_Title__c: Designing an employer hub for an education provider
records.Headline_Metric_Label__c: in the Employer Hub data model, drawn live from the schema on the Pillar A page
records.Challenge__c: Several departments at an education provider worked with the same employer partners, each from its own inbox and spreadsheet. Partners repeated themselves, and nobody could see the whole relationship. Leadership had no shared numbers for engagement, sponsorship or hiring.
records.Solution__c: A working Employer Hub demo built on Salesforce. Every inquiry is captured once from a web form, matched to the partner's account and routed by academic focus area. Service requests are fulfilled from the case, and monetary requests run through an opportunity to a contract. Operations and executive dashboards report from the same records.
records.Business_Value__c: Designed so that employer partners get one front door and a faster answer, departments stop duplicating outreach and see each other's work with a partner, and leadership can report on the employer relationship as a whole.

records.Name: Home case study E
records.Home_Title__c: Building this site as a production org
records.Headline_Metric_Label__c: passing at the last successful deploy, with {coverage}% org-wide coverage
records.Challenge__c: A resume can say someone practises DevOps, but it gives a reviewer nothing to check.
records.Solution__c: This site is its own delivery evidence. Every pull request is validated in a fresh scratch org with the local Apex tests and static analysis, and every merge that changes the app deploys to production through GitHub Actions and runs the local tests. Each run publishes a governance event that is stored as a pipeline run record. The Delivery page shows the latest run per workflow, the Jira roadmap and the recent commits, read from caches that scheduled jobs refresh.
records.Business_Value__c: The test count on this card and the checklist on the Delivery page come from those stored runs, so they change when the pipeline does. A reviewer sees the roadmap, the commits and the latest pipeline results on one page.
